name: Show the app-install QR code and phone instructions
description: Verifies the workspace provides a QR code to open the deployed CMRG Data Collect PWA and device-specific home-screen instructions without Play Store distribution.
steps: Open the main workspace on desktop
Find the Get CMRG Collect on your phone section
Scan the QR code with a phone camera
Follow the device-specific Add to Home Screen instructions
expected: The QR code points to the current app URL, installation instructions explain Android and iPhone steps, and the app uses CMRG red, black and white branding.

name: Create a project and share its QR access link
description: Verifies a manager can create a survey project and obtain a phone-access link and code.
steps: Create a project with a title and at least one question
expected: The project appears in the project list with its questions and a separate QR/share link plus enumerator access code.

name: Submit a field response with GPS and audio status
description: Verifies an enumerator can open a shared project, submit answers, capture location, and see an accurate audio status.
steps: Open the project share link on a phone-sized view
Enter the displayed enumerator access code
Answer the questionnaire and capture location; record audio if browser permission is available
expected: The response appears in the Situation Room with coordinates when permission is granted and a truthful audio status.

name: Import an existing questionnaire
description: Verifies a manager can import a supported questionnaire file and review imported questions before saving.
steps: Import a valid JSON or CSV questionnaire file
expected: Imported questions are shown for review and can be saved into a project; invalid files show a readable validation error.

name: Review and flag fieldwork in Situation Room
covers: audio upload link and server-confirmed storage status
GPS coordinate review and Google Maps preview
description: Verifies a manager can inspect submitted fieldwork and change its review status.
steps: Open Situation Room for a project with a submission
Inspect its location and audio status
Mark the submission as flagged or verified
expected: The submission shows coordinates with a Google Maps preview, provides an interviewer audio-upload link, marks audio Uploaded only after server storage confirms success, and retains review status after refresh.
